title: Chrono Duration
explanation: chrono::duration represents a time interval with a tick count and a period.

title: Chrono Time Point
description: Represent points in time using time_point (C++11)
explanation: time_point represents a specific point in time relative to a clock's epoch.

title: Chrono Measure Elapsed Time
description: Measure code execution time using chrono
explanation: Use steady_clock for reliable elapsed time measurement — it's monotonic and not affected by system clock changes.

title: Chrono Date (C++20)
description: Calendar date and timezone support with chrono (C++20)
explanation: C++20 chrono adds calendar dates (year_month_day), time zones, and convenient date arithmetic.

title: Random Number Generator
description: Generate random numbers using modern C++ random library (C++11)
explanation: Modern C++ random library separates engines (sources of entropy) from distributions (shape of output).

title: Random Shuffle Vector
description: Randomly shuffle elements of a container
explanation: std::shuffle randomly permutes elements. Prefer it over the deprecated std::random_shuffle.

title: Random Weighted Distribution
description: Select from weighted options with discrete distribution
explanation: discrete_distribution lets you assign different probabilities to different outcomes for weighted random selection.

title: Regex Search
description: Search for a pattern in a string using regular expressions (C++11)
explanation: regex_search finds the first substring matching the regex pattern, capturing groups in smatch.

title: Regex Match All
description: Find all regex matches in a string using iterators (C++11)
explanation: sregex_iterator iterates over all non-overlapping matches. regex_token_iterator extracts specific capture groups.

title: Regex Replace
description: Replace pattern matches using regular expressions (C++11)
explanation: regex_replace replaces matched patterns with a formatted string, supporting $1-style back-references.

title: Regex Validation
description: Validate entire string against a regex pattern (C++11)
explanation: regex_match requires the entire string to match the pattern, ideal for input validation.

title: Filesystem Path
explanation: fs::path provides portable path decomposition, concatenation, and normalization across platforms.

title: Filesystem Directory Iteration
explanation: directory_iterator lists files in a directory. recursive_directory_iterator descends into subdirectories.

title: Filesystem File Operations
description: Common file operations using filesystem library (C++17)
explanation: fs provides portable file/directory operations that throw filesystem_error on failure.

title: Filesystem File Info
description: Query file information and metadata using filesystem (C++17)
explanation: fs::file_status and related functions provide portable access to file metadata and type information.

title: Filesystem Symlink
explanation: Symlink operations work on the link itself, not the target. Requires appropriate OS permissions.

title: Filesystem Disk Space
explanation: fs::space returns capacity, free, and available bytes. Available accounts for permissions/quotas.
